english_draft: Oracle published its FY2027 Q1 results on 2026-09-10. The quarter ended on 2026-08-31. Total revenue was USD 19.345 billion. Revenue increased 30 percent year over year. Cloud revenue was USD 11.607 billion. Cloud revenue increased 62 percent year over year. IaaS revenue was about USD 7.4 billion. IaaS revenue increased 121 percent year over year. SaaS revenue was about USD 4.2 billion. SaaS revenue increased 10 percent year over year. GAAP operating income was about USD 6.7 billion. Non-GAAP operating income was about USD 8.2 billion. Remaining performance obligations were USD 664 billion. Free cash flow was negative USD 5 billion. No contemporaneous Preview exists. A later reconstruction is not a valid forecast review. The source provides no forward guidance or consensus. Therefore, this note does not judge beat or miss. The next quarter focus includes IaaS growth, RPO conversion, SaaS growth, and free cash flow improvement.

RPO的6640亿美元中，未来12个月可确认收入占比是多少？如果大部分是多年期合约，当前收入增速能否延续。
